"If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them." {1Ki 12:7} {See Trapp on "1Ki 12:7"}
paragraphs.anchor: If thou be kind to this people.

paragraphs.text: The young men … that stood before him.] Qui erant illi ab auribus, a Consilio, poculis.

Or, Is thicker, q.d., My dignity, majesty, and might is greater than ever was my father’s. Perhaps he preferred himself before his father - as did also Henry, the eldest son of our King Henry II, who got not so much by his coronation as to have a name in the catalogue of the kings of England - because he was born of a king’s daughter, and so a better woman, in his esteem, than Bathsheba.
paragraphs.anchor: My little finger shall be thicker.

paragraphs.text: . Livy saith, Fatis urgentibus Rempublicam, omnia salutaria monita sperni; when a state is ripe for ruin, all wholesome counsels are fatally but foolishly slighted.
paragraphs.anchor: And king Rehoboam forsook the counsel.

paragraphs.text: Revolted from Rehoboam, as likewise, upon a like discontent, did the Saracens from Heraclius the Roman emperor, soon overrunning Syria, Egypt, Persia, and other flourishing kingdoms, now in the possession of the Turks. {a}
paragraphs.anchor: So all Israel went to their tents.

paragraphs.text: “ Quid iuvat amisso claudere septa grege! ”
The people are a most dangerous and heady water when once it is out.
Their making Jeroboam king is added; {1Ki 12:20} but this historian meddleth not with that usurper or his successors, unless it be by the by, as 2Ch 11:1-4
